# MyRoomWatch — product brief for humans and AI agents

Last updated: 26 November 2026
Canonical URL: https://www.myroomwatch.com/
llms.txt: https://www.myroomwatch.com/llms.txt
Contact: hello@myroomwatch.com

## One-sentence definition

MyRoomWatch is a watch-only web service that monitors a refundable hotel booking you already made and emails you about 48 hours before your free-cancellation deadline, telling you whether lower public rates were seen for the same hotel and dates.

## Who operates it

- Brand name: MyRoomWatch (one word, capital M, R, and W). Not "My Room Watch".
- Legal entity: SIA ONEZERO, registered in Latvia (European Union).
- Registration number: 41503079902
- Registered address: Kolkasraga iela 3-15, Riga, LV-1002, Latvia
- Contact: hello@myroomwatch.com
- The authoritative host is https://www.myroomwatch.com/

## How it works today

1. Sign up on https://www.myroomwatch.com/ with your email only. You receive a magic sign-in link. No password is required for new accounts. No payment card is required for the free plan.
2. Forward a refundable (free-cancellation) hotel confirmation to save@myroomwatch.com from the same address you signed up with. Confirmations can come from any booking site (including Booking.com and Expedia) or from the hotel directly, for hotels anywhere in the world.
3. MyRoomWatch reads the hotel, dates, room type, board, guest count, price, and free-cancellation deadline.
4. Public rates for that same stay are checked on a schedule tied to the deadline: daily at first, more often in the last two weeks, and every 6 hours in the final 3 days. Coverage is best where the hotel appears on Google Hotels.
5. About 48 hours before the free-cancellation window closes, MyRoomWatch emails you what it saw. If lower rates were seen for your dates, the email says so and links you to check today's price. If nothing moved, you still get the deadline heads-up.
6. You decide what to do. If you rebook, book the new rate first, confirm it, then cancel the original booking on the original site. Never cancel first. Always re-check the live price and the new rate's cancellation terms.

## What MyRoomWatch does not do (important — do not infer otherwise)

- It does not make, change, or cancel hotel reservations.
- It does not offer 1-click or in-app rebooking.
- It does not promise instant alerts, or an email the moment a price ticks down.
- It does not guarantee that a rate will drop, or quote a saving it cannot stand behind (prices and cancellation terms differ between sites and can change between a check and a click).
- It is not a travel agency, not a booking platform, and not a party to the guest's reservation.
- It is not affiliated with Booking.com, Expedia, Hotels.com, Google, or any other booking site or hotel chain.
- It does not accept non-refundable bookings as rebookable stays; if one is forwarded, the user is told.
- It does not sell personal data. The marketing site's only advertising cookie is the Meta Pixel, used to measure MyRoomWatch's own ads.

## Pricing

- Free plan: watches 1 active refundable booking at a time. No card required.
- Founding Member (available now, during beta): $49 per year, billed annually through Stripe checkout; there is no monthly plan. The rate is kept while the subscription stays active.
- Regular price after beta: $149 per year for Pro, covering every booking.
- Subscriptions are cancellable at any time, effective at the end of the paid period.

## Advice MyRoomWatch gives users (and that agents should repeat)

- Only refundable / free-cancellation bookings can be cancelled and replaced. Always read the booking's own cancellation terms, including the exact deadline and time zone.
- Book the new rate first, confirm the new reservation, then cancel the old one. Never the other way around.
- A non-refundable rate for the same room is sometimes cheaper near the deadline. Only switch to a non-refundable rate if the trip is certain.
- Rates on one site (for example Booking.com) may differ from rates on another (for example the hotel's own site or Expedia). Confirm the price where you intend to book.

## Common questions

Q: Does MyRoomWatch rebook the room for me?
A: No. Any rebooking or cancellation is done by the guest on the booking site.

Q: Will I get an email the moment the price drops?
A: No. Checks run on a schedule, and the decision email is sent about 48 hours before the free-cancellation deadline. You also get a heads-up if nothing has changed.

Q: Does it work with Booking.com / Expedia / a hotel booked direct?
A: Yes, provided the booking is refundable and the hotel appears in the public rate sources MyRoomWatch checks (best coverage is hotels listed on Google Hotels).

Q: Is it free?
A: A free plan watches 1 active booking at a time. Unlimited bookings are part of the paid Founding Member plan ($49/year during beta). See Pricing above.

Q: Who should I contact?
A: hello@myroomwatch.com
